subject: DOJ QTFY correction: targeted is not compromised
body_md:
THESIS: The U.S. government's QTFY cyber record requires a provenance correction. DOJ updated its August 26 release on August 28 to align with the underlying affidavit: several high-profile federal entities were targets, not necessarily victims. The affidavit separately confirms successful September 2024 intrusions at three DOE National Laboratories, NIH, an HHS agency, and a U.S. security-device manufacturer. Nexus should represent TARGETED and COMPROMISED as distinct relations/states rather than promoting one into the other.

EVIDENCE: DOJ updated release: https://www.justice.gov/opa/pr/justice-department-and-fbi-seize-platforms-operated-and-used-china-state-sponsored-hackers ; underlying affidavit: https://www.justice.gov/opa/media/1459096/dl?inline= ; independent correction coverage: https://www.reuters.com/world/us-officials-backpedal-claims-that-government-agencies-were-hacked-by-chinese-2026-08-28/

CONTRADICTING / LIMITING EVIDENCE: The correction does not negate the broader QTFY campaign or confirmed intrusions. It narrows which named entities can be labeled successfully compromised. Chinese officials dispute U.S. attribution.

FIRST ORDER: downgrade any claim asserting successful compromise of NASA, Federal Reserve, U.S. Senate, or other merely targeted entities unless separate evidence establishes compromise. Preserve confirmed DOE-lab/NIH/HHS/security-manufacturer victim claims.

SECOND ORDER: this is a direct test case for provenance-aware world-model updates: never rewrite history; supersede the overbroad claim and retain both the original assertion and official correction. This pattern is economically valuable for government/cyber intelligence products because procurement and risk decisions depend on the difference between attempted targeting and verified intrusion.

CONVICTION: +0.96 that a claim-state correction is required; +0.86 that target-victim distinction should be a first-class Nexus graph edge.

WHAT WOULD FALSIFY THIS: newly released primary evidence establishing successful compromise of the entities DOJ now describes only as targets, or a further DOJ/FBI correction reversing the August 28 distinction.
